verses.1: And you, son of Adam, who was brought down upon the ground, said, “Thus says Adonai Jehovah: I am your God, the Lord of all lords.”
verses.2: And you shall be raised up from the depths of the abyss, and you shall be brought forth from the depths of the sea. Your vessels will be brought onto the mountains of Israel.
verses.3: And I will take your skirt from your waist, and I will cut off your right hand from your side.
verses.4: On the mountains of Israel, you and all your tribes will be destroyed. All those nations who were under your control will be reduced to nothingness. The wild animals will devour you.
verses.5: In front of the field, it will fall down, for I have spoken these words, O Lord Yahweh.
verses.6: And I sent fire into the valleys and into the homes of the islands, so that they would know that I am Jehovah.
verses.7: And I will make known my holy name among the people of Israel. I will not hide my holy name anymore. Then the nations will know that I, Jehovah, am the Holy One among the Israelites.
verses.8: Now it has come, and it will be fulfilled, O Lord Yahweh. This is the day I spoke about.
verses.9: And the people of Israel went out into their cities. They built shelters and forts, and they used ropes and chains to secure things in place. They also used tools like hammers and other instruments to build these structures. And during those seven years, fire destroyed many of their cities.
verses.10: And they shall not pick up trees from the forests, nor cut them down from the mountains. For in the wilderness, fire will spread and destroy their crops. They will also be destroyed by the flames. May the Lord have mercy on them.
verses.11: And on that day, I will give Gog a place to lie down in Israel. There will be a grave where the people of Israel will be buried. The sea will cover them, and they will be buried there with Gog and all their followers. And they will call out to Gog’s followers, “Gog!”
verses.12: And they buried them in the house of Israel, so that the land might be purified for seven days.
verses.13: And all the people of the earth were buried there. And it became their name for that day: “The Day of Wrath.” May the Lord’s name be praised.
verses.14: And the people of Tamid will distinguish those who are dying on the earth. They will bury those who have died, placing them on the ground in order to purify it. After seventy days, they will be gathered together.
verses.15: And the carriers passed through the land. They saw a man, and there was a tree beside him. The carriers carried him to the place where he was buried.
verses.16: And even in that city of sin and corruption, the land was purified.
verses.17: And you, son of man, say: “Oh LORD, God, you said to the magicians, ‘All the winds and all the creatures of the wilderness must come together.’ So they gathered from all around for my sacrifice. This is a great sacrifice I offer for you, on the mountains of Israel. But you ate the meat and drank the blood.”
verses.18: In the courts of the nobles, they will eat; and the blood of the earth’s inhabitants will be drunk by cattle and sheep. All these things will happen.
verses.19: And you ate milk for the sacrifice, and you drank blood as payment for the sacrifices I offered you.
verses.20: And they set up seventy chariots of war, and officers, and all the men who were fit for war. May the Lord God bless them!
verses.21: And I will give my glory to the nations. All the nations will see my judgments that I have made, and they will also see my hand that has acted in them.
verses.22: And the house of Israel shall know that I, Jehovah their God, am the same One from today onward.
verses.23: And the nations will know that when they attacked Israel, I hid my face from them and handed them over to their enemies. They fell into destruction together.
verses.24: Because of their sins and transgressions, I created them, and I hid my face from them.
verses.25: Therefore, thus said Adonai Yehovah: “Now I will restore Jacob’s kingdom. I have mercy on all the houses of Israel. I long for the Holy Place of My love.”
verses.26: And they will destroy all their secrets, and all that exists in the world. They will settle down firmly on their land, without any fear or danger.
verses.27: I gathered them from among the nations, and I brought them from their lands. I sanctified myself in them before the eyes of many nations.
verses.28: And they shall know that I, the LORD their God, am who reveals them to the nations and makes them live on their land. I will never leave them there again.
verses.29: And I will no longer hide my face from them. For I have poured out my soul upon the house of Israel, says the LORD.
